items.title: IPCC’s Sixty-Fifth Session
items.description: GENEVA, Oct 29 – The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) will resume its Sixty-Fifth Session (IPCC-65) from 1 to 3 December 2026. The meeting will be held virtually. At the resumed session, the IPCC member governments will primarily consider two remaining agenda items: the Work Plan for the IPCC Seventh Assessment Report (AR7) and […]
